prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Baytown, Texas. Injury: whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1478; do not mention it.)
text: I was turning left at a green light onto the main road in Baytown, Texas, when a white pickup truck came through the intersection from the opposite direction and struck the front passenger side of my car. I had already started my turn and was moving slowly, so I did not see the truck until the moment of impact. My airbags did not deploy, but the force threw my head back and forward. The next morning I woke up with stiffness and pain in my neck and upper back, and I have since been diagnosed with whiplash. I have been unable to drive for several days and am attending physical therapy. The other driver told the officer at the scene that they had been looking at their phone. I am providing this statement so the claim can be processed as soon as possible.
